description: Machine-checkable field requirements for B10-R03 revision-bound research snapshots; not a production multi-text schema.

field_rules.accession_id: unique non-empty ASCII identifier stable for the fixed title and oldid
field_rules.oldid: positive integer as string or number; null only when capture_status is unavailable
field_rules.permanent_url: HTTPS replay URL containing the fixed oldid when capture_status is complete
field_rules.raw_path: repository-relative path under corpus/research_sources/related-wikisource; null only when no source object was captured
field_rules.raw_sha256: lowercase 64-hex digest of exact raw UTF-8 bytes
field_rules.raw_byte_count: non-negative integer for exact raw UTF-8 bytes

forbidden_interpretations: capture_status complete does not assert the ancient work is complete
same-family mirrors do not count as independent witnesses by agreement alone
research mapping does not approve a rule or human review decision
raw snapshot must not be replaced by normalized punctuation or translation
